The Clarity Act protects everyday Americans and their hard-earned money, gives entrepreneurs a fair shot to build and create jobs here at home, and strengthens our national security by making it harder for criminals and foreign adversaries to exploit our financial system. 
 
I’m grateful to @SenateAgGOP Chairman @JohnBoozman and @SenLummis for their partnership, and I look forward to working together to get this bill across the finish line.
